questions.prompt: Explain why uneven heating of Earth leads to winds and ocean currents.
questions.modelAnswer: The Sun heats Earth unevenly: the equator more than the poles, and land faster than sea. Warm air rises, creating low pressure, and cooler, denser air flows in from high-pressure areas, which is wind. Winds push surface water, and differences in water temperature and saltiness make water sink or rise, creating ocean currents. Together they carry heat from warm to cold regions.
